notes.subject: ol meri bilong Yerusalayim
notes.rationale: Direct address to the daughters of Jerusalem, climactic close of the description.

notes.subject: חכו
notes.rationale: Literally 'his palate', rendered 'insait bilong maus' — the mouth as organ of taste and speech.

notes.subject: דודי/רעי
notes.rationale: Paired 'my beloved / my companion' — covenant-echo of Isaiah 41:8 'Avraham ohavi', friend and beloved together.

translation: Insait bilong maus bilong em i swit tru, na olgeta bilong em i ol samting ol i laikim tru. Em yet man bilong mi, na em yet poro bilong mi, ol meri bilong Yerusalayim.

tokens.gloss: ol samting ol i laikim tru
